analysis.original_request: 我负责一台用于石化园区和海上风电场甲烷泄漏巡检的短波红外成像相机前端防护窗口研发。为了在白天强太阳背景下提高甲烷吸收特征的信噪比，相机需要尽可能完整地接收 1000–1700 nm 波段的短波红外信号，同时尽可能反射 300–450 nm 波段的近紫外和蓝光杂散辐射，以降低太阳散射背景和探测器的杂散响应。请在空气入射、熔融石英基底的条件下，仅使用 HfO2 和 SiO2 设计一个平面多层介质膜，膜系总层数不超过 30 层。
analysis.normalized_request_english: Design a planar multilayer dielectric coating on a fused silica substrate with unspecified material incidence using only HfO2 and SiO2 materials. The coating should maximize transmittance in the 1000-1700 nm band and maximize reflectance in the 300-450 nm band. The total number of layers must not exceed 30.
analysis.compatibility_reason: Request specifies planar isotropic dielectric layers solvable via transfer-matrix method.
manufacturing_constraints: materials restricted to HfO2 and SiO2
ambiguities: angle of incidence not explicitly specified
